# Nutshell CRM | Product Overview

Nutshell CRM is an easy-to-use CRM for small and medium-sized B2B sales and marketing teams that includes forms, land pages, chats and AI results quotas. The product core builds a unified workspace around customer relations, sales implementation and revenue processes, reducing fragmentation tools and manual maintenance.
